text:
Maya R: Heads up — seeing a sudden spike in 429s from the EU-west GPU pools over the last 7m. Majority of traffic looks like the new SDK heartbeat; volume up ~4x. Cc @Jorge L @Priya K

infra-bot: Alert: admission-rate exceeded for pool eu-west-3. 429 emission window opened (link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/adm-102).

Jorge L: Are those heartbeat messages carrying our admission headers? If heartbeats are small but still need admission slots they can starve real inference requests.

Priya K: We rolled the heartbeat beta from 30s -> 5s to improve cold-start UX. I think clients are polling too aggressively and each poll hits admission control.

Priya K: Example payload header we send today (SDK v0.9.2):
```
X-Client-Version: sdk-0.9.2
X-Client-Heartbeat: true
```

Sam B: Oof. If they don't include admit hints the runtime treats them as normal requests. Two immediate options: rollback the client change or make runtime emit stronger admission hints (Retry-After + per-client throttle header) so SDKs backoff instead of hammering.

Priya K: I'll open a hotfix to revert heartbeat timing in the SDK, but it might take a few minutes to reach all active users. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/3218

Sam B: We should also add an `X-Admission-Hint: low-priority` (or numeric admit-window) header from the runtime so that upgraded SDKs can deprioritize heartbeats. Suggest header semantics: `X-Admission-Hint: window=0` (do not consume admission slot; treat as background).

Jorge L: Agreed. Also propose `X-Admission-Offset` that tells client how many tokens left in current admit window. SDKs can use that to pace.

Ops Oncall: For immediate mitigation, we can enable per-client fingerprint throttling — throttle by `Authorization` token hash or `X-Client-Fingerprint`. We should be careful with privacy but hashing token is ok for short-term. Also recommend server-side Retry-After + jittered backoff guidance to reduce synchronized retries.

Maya R: Can infra temporarily set stricter admission rules on eu-west-3 to allow fallthrough to other regions? We don't want a full region cascade.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: platform/admission-policy canary -> eu-west-3 (10% instances).

Priya K: SDK hotfix landed and published to staging. It will respect `X-Admission-Hint` and backoff on `Retry-After`. Rolling to prod now.

Sam B: After we have the SDK change, let's run a 10-minute open window where runtime will emit `X-Admission-Hint: window=0` for heartbeat endpoints only. We'll monitor queue depth and 429 rate.

Maya R: Sounds good — schedule: rollback if 429 rate doesn't drop 50% within 5m of the patch. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Metric update: 429 rate in eu-west-3 down 62% (3m) after canary policy.

Ops Oncall: Follow-up items: (1) Add per-client fingerprint header to SDK, (2) Runtime to support numeric admit-window and offset headers, (3) Docs for SDK backoff semantics. I'll create tickets.

Maya R: Filed as ENG-OPS-521, ENG-PLT-522, and DOCS-134. Closing loop once metrics stable.
